newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq closes slightly higher, MCI halted.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq closes slightly higher, MCI halted.

text.p: Nasdaq shares closed higher due to strength in MCI Communications Corp on news it was merging with British Telecommunications Plc.
MCI shares were halted at 1328 EST/1928 GMT for news pending and had not reopened by the close of trading. The last sale was 30-1/4. Nasdaq said that MCI has requested a continued trading halt.
Analysts said that elsewhere Nasdaq was falling prey to profit-taking and indications were it was ready to move lower.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 0.27 points, or 0.02 percent at 1221.78 at its unofficial close while declines led advancing issues by 2255 to 1837 on volume of about 550 million shares.
"MCI was up big time and that was a real positive," said Dennis Young, head of OTC trading at Dain Bosworth. "But we have been undergoing profit-taking for some time.
"Most of the techs are down. We've been seeing profit-taking for 10 days now and the market is acting as though it wants to go lower. If the dollar breaks that will become an issue."
